title: Admin Operations and Runtime Settings
summary: P142 starts with a contract-only admin operations and runtime settings boundary. P142.1 defines display-safe admin policy, feature gate, maintenance control, runtime state, audit surface, and authority flag shapes while all write and execution authority remains blocked.
detail: P142.1 is contract/policy/safety-boundary work only. P142.2 remains planned-only for the future read-only settings model.
reuseCheck: Reuse os-roadmap/updatePhaseStatus.js patterns when status helper automation is needed.
Reuse existing dashboard tabs/cards/badges and route matrix in P142.4.
Reuse existing evidence/audit/activity helpers in later P142 model or UX subphases.

Do not duplicate report writers, mode guards, redaction helpers, checker formatters, result envelopes, phase status updaters, route matrices, UI cards, tabs, status components, or activity/evidence/audit appenders.

subphases.title: Contract / Policy / Safety Boundary
subphases.narrowGoal: Start P142 with an implementation-grade admin operations and runtime settings contract, seven-subphase split, safety boundary, checker, docs/status handoff, and planned-only P142.2 handoff.
schemas: Contract-only shapes for admin settings policy, feature gates, maintenance controls, runtime operational state, admin audit surface, and authority flags.
subphases.dataShape: P142.1 adds contract-only display-safe data shapes and may refresh route-wide OS Roadmap assertions. No settings store, feature flag engine, maintenance executor, runtime state writer, audit exporter, DB adapter, dashboard source, or live execution is added.
commandCenterUxRequirements: P142.1 does not edit dashboard source, labels, routes, controls, or theme behavior.
P142.1 may update route-wide Playwright assertions to follow the current OS Roadmap handoff.
P142.4 owns future scoped Settings/Admin Operations UX changes.

Primary UX must not show raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, internal phase labels outside OS Roadmap, demo surfaces outside demo mode, raw private project IDs, mutation buttons, or fake runnable admin actions.
themeRequirements: Validate through existing route-wide Command Center coverage.
safetyRules: Do not enable admin setting mutation, feature toggles, feature rollouts, maintenance execution, maintenance scheduling, runtime state mutation, DB/runtime writes, audit export, raw log exposure, raw state exposure, credential handling, or secret value reads in P142.1.
Do not call providers/models, execute tools, start MCP servers, dispatch agents, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend.
Do not add settings write APIs, feature flag engines, maintenance executors, runtime state writers, audit exporters, credential readers, or provider control paths.
Do not expose raw private IDs, dump-style internal payloads, raw logs, raw policy dumps, or runnable admin operations in primary UX.
reuseCheck: Reuse os-roadmap/updatePhaseStatus.js patterns when status helper automation is needed.
Reuse existing dashboard route matrix and Settings page patterns in P142.4.
Reuse existing evidence/audit/activity helpers in later P142 subphases.
Do not duplicate report writers, checker formatters, phase status updaters, route matrices, UI cards/tabs/status components, or activity/evidence/audit appenders.
playWrightTests: Reuse existing route-wide Command Center safety coverage.
Reuse existing Settings route smoke coverage if present.
Only dashboard/tests/routes.spec.js may change for stale OS Roadmap assertions in P142.1.
